settings.question: How do I choose the right device case?
settings.answer: Select the exact phone model shown in the product options. Similar device names do not guarantee the same fit.

settings.question: How does personalization work?
settings.answer: Where available, enter a name and choose the style, colour and placement in the product customizer. Review the preview before adding the item to cart.

settings.question: How can I contact Lumasela?
settings.answer: Use the contact form and include your device model and the product you are considering.
